title: dont repeat password email fields
rule: Don’t repeat password/email fields; confirm on a later page instead.

citation.source: NN/g — A Checklist for Registration and Login Forms on Mobile

pass_when: Email and password are each asked once; confirmation is a later page, not a second identical field.
fail_when: Confirm-email or confirm-password duplicate fields on the same form.
overview: Ask email and password once; confirm on a later page, not with duplicate fields.
apply_when: Building registration or login forms that might request confirm-email or confirm-password.
not_when: Not for genuinely distinct fields such as current versus new password.
agent_hint: Collect email and password once; confirm later on another page, not duplicate fields.
description: Do not repeat password or email fields on the same form. Ask each once and confirm on a later page instead of a second identical field that invites paste mismatches and typos. Fail for confirm-email or confirm-password duplicate fields on the same form. Later-page confirmation replaces the duplicate field pattern. Apply on registration or login forms that might otherwise request confirm-email or confirm-password.
